font.usage: Wordmark and BY SINGLETON SD caps line use 500. Regular (400) and Bold (700) are vendored for the rasterizer. Must not fall back to a system font.

tokens.note: Authoritative semantic ids for product yellows/grays. SVG masters keep baked hex and do not import the package at runtime. LeaseMate uses Singleton gold/yellow plus neutrals (black, white, grays) — no product accent. Link (#8E5C00) and focus (gray-900) in ui arrive in tokens 1.7.0 (pending).

yellowDark500.usage: primary mark on dark / black backgrounds

yellowLight500.usage: primary mark on light / white backgrounds

gray500.usage: rooms on dark; BY SINGLETON SD caps; dark gray bar
gray500.note: Legacy camelCase key gray500; hex matches tokens gray-600, not gray-500 (#9DA1A6).

gray300.usage: muted gray accents on light themes (core Singleton token; not used in the mark itself)

grayLight500.usage: rooms on light; light gray bar

ui.note: Never use gold as text on white. Link and focus hexes arrive in tokens 1.7.0 (pending).

designSource: LeaseMate brand overlay — house icon (56-unit grid) + Plus Jakarta Sans lockup, Singleton gold/black only
